notes: SEAS has no departments (by its own description) and spans applied math, applied physics, bioengineering, computer science, electrical/computer engineering, environmental science & engineering, and materials science & mechanical engineering. The directory (185 results, paginated 20/page via ?page=%2CN) was read in full; every record with a 'Professor' title (140) was recorded as a lab, judged only from the title string shown -- not individually verified whether each runs a wet/dry lab, a theory group, or similar; everyone else (lecturers, preceptors, directors of undergraduate/graduate studies, a postdoc, a research scientist) went to non_lab_people. This is a breadth pass only: pi_email/phone/office come from the directory, but lab_website, research_summary, member_count and join info are still null for all 140 and need a later per-PI pass. Several SEAS faculty are already recorded with fuller detail elsewhere (e.g. Wyss Institute faculty in wyss.json, Jarad Mason in harvard-chemistry.json) -- expect overlap, not an error.
